note: Board-formed concrete wall with visible timber grain and tie holes, cut diagonally by the hard black shadow of a projecting soffit
why: Literal board-formed concrete meeting a hard shadow line; warm raking light, two calm flat fields, no sky, no people

note: Near-black facade of staggered dark metal and glass panels seen at a raking angle, filling the frame as a repeating grid
why: Restrained monochrome structural rhythm with no sky and no lit windows - a facade skin, not a corporate tower

note: Black and white interior stairwell void where a ceiling light slot throws a single hard wedge of daylight down a white wall, stair balustrade in silhouette at right
why: Pure chiaroscuro - one light source with intent, most of the frame black, enormous calm negative space for type

note: Monochrome dusk view of a low glass-and-concrete pavilion behind a long board-formed wall, mirrored in the still dark water of a reflecting pool, bare branches overhead
why: Contemporary modernist wall beside still dark water with a true mirror reflection; overcast grey, no colour, no people, no signage

note: Low sun raking through a full-height vertical louvre screen, scattering bands and dapples of light across a polished stone floor in an otherwise dark room
why: Light is unambiguously the subject; monochrome, low-key, black foreground mass, exactly the brise-soleil-on-stone idea

note: Near-black mountain ridge filling the lower frame with cloud tearing across it in white ribbons, a pale misty valley and further ridges receding above at first light
why: Vast, quiet, almost monochrome horizon study; dark muted tonality and a huge calm dark field, with no saturated blue sky
